title: 科幻
visual: coherent technology rules, readable scale, practical surfaces, motivated interface light only when story-relevant
performance: characters react to specific system changes and physical consequences rather than staring at screens
camera: use scale reveals, inserts for evidence, and motivated movement through space
audio: native machinery, alarms, pressure, radio texture, environmental resonance, and sparse score
avoid: decorative floating UI, illegible text, random neon, unexplained effects, static exposition
